landing.heroTitle: From briefing to approval — no spreadsheet chaos.
landing.heroSubtitle: The operating system for content managers who produce, align, and approve posts with clients — in one place.
landing.problemBody: Captions in Docs, art in Drive, feedback on WhatsApp, deadlines in Notion. Clients lose context — you lose time.
landing.howTitle: One flow, from briefing to post.

1.body: AI-guided briefing and visual kit (colors, fonts, voice).

2.title: Produce faster
2.body: Copy, scripts, and art aligned to the project and calendar.

3.title: Approve in preview
3.body: Clients comment and approve in an Instagram-style feed, with version history.
